evidence_limitations: Registered means Registry presence only; authoring_status reports static source quality separately.
Route coverage uses deterministic fixtures and does not prove live router precision or recall.
Behavior and release-critical coverage use checked-in captured outputs and phrase obligations, not fresh model runs.
Pressure coverage counts executed primary and Layer 3 fixture roles, not a merely declared reviewer.
No wall-clock performance, production accuracy, or installed user experience is proved.

state_definitions.registered: present in the owning source Registry
state_definitions.route_covered: selected by at least one passing deterministic route
state_definitions.negative_route_covered: explicitly excluded by at least one passing deterministic route
state_definitions.behavior_covered: selected by at least one passing positive captured benchmark with no forbidden behavior hit
state_definitions.pressure_covered: executed as primary or selected Layer 3 in at least one passing pressure fixture
state_definitions.release_critical_covered: selected by at least one passing release-critical benchmark
